mapper.select: SELECT request_fingerprint AS fingerprint, receipt_json FROM knowledge_evaluation_decision_command WHERE AND key_hash = #{key}

mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_evaluation_review_head h JOIN knowledge_evaluation_review_revision r USING (run_id, manifest_digest, question_id, revision) WHERE r.tenant_id = #{caller.tenantId} AND r.owner_id = #{caller.userId} AND r.run_id = #{runId} AND r.manifest_digest = #{manifest} ORDER BY r.question_id
